{{Top|leg}}
'''Radiation-absorbing foam''' was utilized by [[decon droid]]s aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to clear [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. They spread the foam throughout the contaminated areas of the ship, then collected the foam and rendered it inert within their internal decontamination chambers.
